title: The Wealthy and Unethical

lines.text: Rich people are more likely to be unethical.
A study by Piff and colleagues found this.
They observed drivers at crosswalks in San Francisco.
Higher-status vehicles were more likely to ignore pedestrians.
Out of 152 drivers, 34.9% failed to yield.
This finding highlights class-related differences in behavior.

sources: Piff et al. (2012). Higher social class predicts increased unethical behavior. PNAS 109(11):4086-4091.
